component.name: X50 Patch Switcher
component.summary: Find and select sounds on a KORG X50 over MIDI

description.p: A small desktop app that finds programs and combinations by name or address and selects them on a KORG X50 over USB-MIDI, with a full-screen live view of large buttons for the sounds of the current set.
It never writes to the synthesizer. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by KORG Inc.
